title: Hinomori Shizuku — Focusing On What Lies Ahead〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, the bath's ready for you anytime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, no... Not really.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, that can't be!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa! H-Hey, personal space...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You looked like you wanted to say something just now, Shii. It's okay. You can tell me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I get it!
Just gimme some breathing room first...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not like anything's wrong...
But you seem a lot more cheerful compared to yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...? I do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I hadn't thought that, I wouldn't have done a double take. Anyway, you seem to have found a solution to whatever was bothering you, so we don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we do!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, personal space...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's very, very, very important to me that you noticed, Shii!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I already told Mom and Dad, so you should also know, Shii. The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're going to be on TV...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. After discussing it with Haruka, Minori and Airi, we decided to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's great.
It'll be a great chance for your group to really get your name out there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's sort of why we decided to accept.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll do just fine, but we promise to not cause any trouble for you and our family.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry about us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I appreciate the thought, but you shouldn't have to think about what-ifs since I'm fairly certain that you guys already have a lot on your plate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku, how do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: H-How do I feel?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About how you're gonna appear to others, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii. I really appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually... People who haven't been watching our streams may be in for a bit of a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my goal is to just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We went through quite a lot in the beginning, but I want everybody to learn more about Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess there's nothing to worry about since Momoi, Kiritani and Minori will be there with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so sweet of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While we're at it, Shii, why don't we take a bath together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No way. Also, I already took one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, you'll need to keep the fact that we'll be appearing on TV a secret. We only just sent our acceptance reply.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know.
Promise to tell me once you know when it's supposed to air.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you'll watch it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
If I have time.
Oh, Saki's probably gonna want to watch it no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can see that.
Then, I'll let you know when we have an air date.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm going to my room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you for letting me know that the bath is ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii and the others are all going to watch. That means we need to make the most of our iHaz appearance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.
